quality_gate: No altered model is production-ready without independent inference and task-quality evaluation.

embed.policy: Already small enough. Preserve pretrained embedding weights; no pruning required.

mellum.policy: Build experimental E8 candidate using router L2 ranking, retain all 28 layers. Quality unvalidated.

qwen27.policy: Blocked for this budget: Q4 fixed non-layer tensors alone exceed the weight allowance. Width/vocabulary changes need training and an architecture adapter.

bonsai.policy: Special PTQ1_0 type 143 and Hadamard metadata need the matching runtime and a topology adapter. Do not silently requantize ternary weights.

xing.policy: Expert-only pruning cannot meet this budget; nonexpert tensors alone exceed 4 GB. Hyper-connections, MLA and prediction layers need a separate adapter.

flash.policy: Split 177B model: the audited first shard is incomplete and nonexpert tensors exceed the budget. The second shard and PLE tensors must be accounted for; not a local 2 GB candidate.
